attack: a real stamp over a fidelity reading that is off by one compared
why: the stamped numbers must equal the numbers the gate recomputes from the receipts
wouldBeWrongIf: READY, or a refusal that never says the reading was recomputed

allowedSecondary.AUDIT_FIDELITY_COUNTS_INCONSISTENT: compared != liveTools also fires; a weaker check than the recomputation
allowedSecondary.AUDIT_FIDELITY_GAPS: only if gaps differed, which they do not
